noted: She is a noted scientist whose work on climate change has won many awards.
她是一位著名的科学家，她在气候变化方面的研究获得过许多奖项。
memorandum: The manager sent a memorandum to all staff about the new holiday policy.
经理向全体员工发了一份关于新休假政策的备忘录。
shady: We sat under a shady tree to escape the hot afternoon sun.
我们坐在一棵阴凉的树下，躲避午后炎热的阳光。
countermeasure: The company introduced new security software as a countermeasure against online attacks.
公司引入了新的安全软件，作为应对网络攻击的对策。
worldly: Traveling for years made him wise and worldly beyond his age.
多年的旅行使他变得智慧而通达，远超同龄人。
legislator: Each legislator must vote on the new tax bill before Friday.
每位立法者都必须在周五之前对新税法案进行表决。
denationalize: The government decided to denationalize the railway industry and allow private companies to run trains.
政府决定使铁路行业非国有化，允许私营公司运营火车。
validation: The experiment provided strong validation of the researcher's original idea.
这项实验为研究者最初的想法提供了有力的证实。
unethical: Cheating on exams is not only against the rules but also clearly unethical.
考试作弊不仅违反规定，而且显然是不道德的。
mysteriously: The old letters mysteriously disappeared from the locked drawer overnight.
那些旧信件一夜之间神秘地从锁着的抽屉里消失了。
postdoctoral: After finishing her PhD, she took a postdoctoral position at a university in Canada.
完成博士学业后，她在加拿大一所大学获得了一个博士后职位。
bipartisan: The two major parties reached a bipartisan agreement on education reform.
两大政党就教育改革达成了两党共识。
dysfunction: Sleep problems are often linked to dysfunction of the body's internal clock.
睡眠问题常常与人体生物钟的失调有关。
frankly: Frankly speaking, I don't think this plan will save us any money.
坦率地说，我认为这个计划不会为我们节省任何钱。
thrilling: Climbing to the top of the mountain was a thrilling experience for the whole team.
攀登到山顶对全队来说是一次令人兴奋的经历。
undocumented: Many undocumented workers are afraid to ask for help from the police.
许多无证明文件的工人不敢向警察求助。
drastically: The new law has drastically reduced the amount of pollution in the river.
新法律极大地减少了这条河流的污染量。
hack: The criminals tried to hack into the bank's computer system last night.
昨晚犯罪分子试图入侵银行的计算机系统。
subsequently: He failed the first test, but subsequently he passed it with a high score.
他第一次考试没通过，但随后他以高分通过了。
allegedly: The man allegedly stole the car, but the court has not yet made a decision.
据称该男子偷了这辆车，但法院尚未作出判决。
deduction: There was an unexpected deduction from my salary this month.
这个月我的工资被扣了一笔意想不到的款项。
pessimist: A pessimist always expects the worst to happen, even in good times.
悲观主义者即使在好的时候也总是预期最坏的情况发生。
ruling: The court's ruling surprised both sides of the long legal battle.
法院的裁定让这场旷日持久的法律官司的双方都感到意外。
groundless: The rumors about the company's closing turned out to be completely groundless.
关于公司倒闭的谣言结果证明完全没有根据。
surgical: The surgeon explained the surgical procedure carefully before the operation began.
手术开始前，外科医生仔细解释了手术程序。
lobbyist: A lobbyist for the drug companies tried to influence the new health law.
制药公司的一名游说者试图影响新医疗法的制定。
handgun: The police officer found a loaded handgun in the suspect's car.
警察在嫌疑人的车里发现了一把装了子弹的手枪。
detached: The judge remained detached and listened to both sides without emotion.
法官保持冷静超然，不带感情地听取了双方的陈述。
fearlessly: The young reporter fearlessly asked the difficult questions no one else would ask.
这位年轻记者无所畏惧地提出了其他人都避而不谈的难题。
randomly: The teacher randomly chose five students to answer the questions.
老师随机挑选了五名学生来回答问题。
tradeoff: Choosing a bigger apartment closer to work involves a tradeoff between cost and space.
选择一个离工作地点更近的更大公寓需要在成本和空间之间进行权衡。
grunt: The tired old man gave a grunt and sat down without saying a word.
疲惫的老人咕哝了一声，一言不发地坐了下来。
outermost: The earth's outermost layer is called the crust.
地球最外面的一层被称为地壳。
datum: Each datum collected from the survey must be checked before it is used.
从调查中收集的每一条数据在使用前都必须经过核对。
bourgeois: The novel describes the comfortable but boring bourgeois life of a small town.
这部小说描写了一个小镇上舒适却乏味的中产阶级生活。
torque: This powerful engine produces much more torque than the old one.
这台大功率发动机产生的扭矩比旧发动机大得多。
watchful: Keep a watchful eye on the children while they play near the water.
孩子们在水边玩耍时，要密切注意他们。
axial: The engineer measured the axial movement of the machine's main shaft.
工程师测量了机器主轴的轴向移动。
ambient: The soft ambient music made the small cafe feel warm and relaxing.
轻柔的背景音乐让这家小咖啡馆显得温馨而令人放松。
perimeter: Guards patrol the perimeter of the airport every two hours.
警卫每两小时在机场外围巡逻一次。
